edge_cases.description: Lifecycle transitions rejected before calling Wasabi
Object lock days xor years and mode validation
Policy JSON validated (dict or str) before PutBucketPolicy
Replication versioning parity checked on both buckets before PutBucketReplication

Cross-account replication: the parity check calls GetBucketLocation/GetBucketVersioning on the destination bucket with the source account's keys, which may be denied for a bucket in another account and block the call
bucket_acl_set/object_acl_set with grants=[] passes validation and would send an empty grant list (removing all access, owner included)
Inventory optional fields, frequency, versions and CSV-only validated
